title: Tampon Metals and the Vaginal Microbiome: The Blind Spot in the Risk Assessment
description: A toxicological risk assessment found tampon metals pose negligible systemic risk. But bioavailable there means absorbed into the blood, and the vaginal microbial community on the tampon surface was never assessed.

title: Iron Fortification and the Kenyan Infant Gut Microbiome
description: A full review of Jaeggi et al. (Gut 2015): iron-fortified porridge increased pathogenic E. coli and enterobacteria, cut bifidobacteria, and inflamed the gut in Kenyan infants.

title: The Metal-Microbiome-Disease Axis: How Heavy Metals May Drive Disease Through the Gut
description: The metal-microbiome-disease axis: heavy-metal exposure reshapes the gut microbiome, and that dysbiosis may drive metabolic, neurological and gut disease.

title: Metals, the Microbiome, and Parkinson's: A Gut-First Pathway to Neurodegeneration
description: How heavy-metal exposure may reshape the gut microbiome and feed gut-first alpha-synuclein pathology in Parkinson's disease - a metallomic-microbiome view.

title: Mercury, Methylmercury, and the Microbiome: How Gut Microbes Shape Neurotoxic Risk
description: How gut microbes methylate and demethylate mercury via hgcAB and merB, how mercury reshapes the microbiome, and why this shapes methylmercury neurotoxic risk.

title: How Low-Dose Heavy Metals May Reshape the Gut Microbiome to Drive Obesity
description: Low-dose arsenic, cadmium, and lead may reshape the gut microbiome, depleting SCFA producers and promoting obesity and metabolic syndrome. Evidence examined.

title: How Dietary Nickel Arms Gut Bacteria — and May Fuel Gut Disease
description: Dietary nickel activates nickel-dependent virulence enzymes in gut Enterobacteriaceae — a mechanistic pathway that may link nickel exposure to NEC and IBD.

title: Feeding the Enemy: How Dietary Iron Reshapes the Gut Microbiome and Raises Enteric Infection Risk
description: Unabsorbed iron can alter the gut microbiome and intestinal inflammation. Human trials show that effects on diarrhea vary by setting and formulation.

title: Does Lead Harm the Developing Brain Through the Gut Microbiome?
description: Animal and human cohort studies link lead exposure to gut microbiome dysbiosis, a candidate mediator of lead's neurodevelopmental harm via the gut-brain axis.

title: Cadmium and the Gut Microbiome: A Hidden Route to Metabolic Disease
description: Cadmium reshapes the gut microbiome, depletes Lachnospiraceae, weakens the gut barrier, and is linked to hepatic and metabolic dysfunction. An evidence review.

title: Arsenic and the Gut Microbiome: A Two-Way Street
description: Arsenic reshapes the gut microbiome, and gut bacteria shape arsenic's toxicity in return. See the bidirectional evidence linking metals, microbes, and disease.

title: Six Decades of Fertilizer Use Built a Legacy of Cadmium, Nickel, and Lead in Soils and Diets
description: A food metallomics review (1960–2025) showing how phosphate and urea fertilizers loaded soils, crops, and diets with cadmium, nickel, lead, and chromium.

title: Heavy Metals and Microbial Metallomics: A New Framework for the US Obesity Epidemic
description: How dietary cadmium, arsenic, lead, and nickel may disrupt gut microbial metallomics—driving dysbiosis, inflammation, and insulin resistance behind obesity.

title: Developmental Readiness Is Not Toxicokinetic Safety: Heavy Metals in Vegetable-Based Baby Foods
description: Developmental readiness for solids does not ensure toxicokinetic safety: leafy greens, brassicas and root crops concentrate lead, cadmium and arsenic in baby foods.

title: Concentration-Based Heavy Metal Standards to Reduce Real Exposure in Infant and Child Foods
description: HMTc 2026 sets concentration-based, as-sold action levels for lead, arsenic, cadmium, mercury, nickel and other heavy metals in infant and child foods.

title: Nickel as a Catalytic Driver of Necrotizing Enterocolitis
description: Dietary nickel in infant formula may activate nickel-dependent microbial enzymes (urease, glyoxalase I) that drive necrotizing enterocolitis in preterm infants.

title: A Unified Model for FIP-Associated Gingivitis in Cats: Disrupting Microbial Shielding and Restoring Nutritional Immunity
description: How itraconazole and lactoferrin may treat FIP-linked gingivitis in cats by disrupting polymicrobial biofilms and restoring metal-based nutritional immunity.

title: Microbiome Medicine Journal: Restoring Causal Structure to Disease Through Microbial Metallomics
description: Microbiome Medicine Journal Vol. I sets out a mechanism-first framework linking microbial ecology, host metallome regulation, and metal dyshomeostasis to disease.

title: From Dysbiosis to Dyshomeostasis: Reframing Parkinson's Through a Metallomic–Microbiome Lens
description: A metallomics framework reframes Parkinson's as metal dyshomeostasis: iron, manganese, copper, zinc and nickel dysregulation drives dysbiosis and neuron loss.

title: The MC1R–Parkinson's Link May Be a Metallomic Story, Not a Cosmetic One
description: A hypothesis linking MC1R red-hair variants to Parkinson's risk via melanin-metal chemistry: how copper, zinc, and iron shape neuromelanin's redox buffering.

title: Parkinson's Disease as a Disorder of Metal Dyshomeostasis Amplified by Microbial Ecology
description: A synthesis framework proposing Parkinson's disease begins with heavy-metal dyshomeostasis that drives ferroptosis, gut dysbiosis, and α-synuclein pathology.

title: Prenatal Tobacco Exposure and the Child Gut Microbiome
description: Prenatal smoking and childhood gut taxa were associated in an observational cohort; the responsible exposure components remain unresolved.

title: Prenatal Metal Exposure, the Gut Microbiome, and Childhood Intestinal Inflammation
description: A 2024 PROGRESS cohort study links prenatal copper and cesium exposure, interacting with specific gut microbes, to elevated fecal calprotectin in children.

title: Prenatal Acetaminophen, the Infant Gut Microbiome, and Childhood Cognition
description: GESTE cohort links prenatal acetaminophen and caffeine to childhood gut microbiome shifts and cognition; Proteobacteria abundance modified WISC-IV scores.

title: Pediatric Gut Microbiome Composition in Health: What a Systematic Review Reveals
description: A systematic review of 42 studies finds geography, diet, and 16S sequencing method, not age, shape healthy children's Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes gut profiles.

title: Lactoferrin vs. Ferrous Sulfate Through a Metallomics Lens
description: Meta-analyses show oral lactoferrin can match or outperform ferrous sulfate for iron repletion, lowering IL-6 and hepcidin with fewer gut side effects.

title: Lactobacillus plantarum 299v and Oral Iron Therapy Tolerance
description: A randomized trial shows the probiotic Lactobacillus plantarum 299v reduces oral iron side effects and improves iron status in iron-deficiency anemia patients.

title: Iron- and Zinc-Biofortified Foods and the Gut Microbiota
description: Systematic review of iron/zinc-biofortified bean and wheat diets in the Gallus gallus model: staples raised SCFA-producing Lactobacillus and cut enteric pathogens.

title: Iron Supplements and the Gut Microbiome in Reproductive-Age Women: A Randomized Controlled Trial
description: A 21-day randomized placebo-controlled trial found ferrous fumarate did not significantly alter fecal microbiome composition in Australian reproductive-age women.

title: Iron Fortification, the Infant Gut Microbiome, and Diarrhea Risk
description: Iron fortification shifts the infant gut microbiome toward enterobacteria and pathogenic E. coli, cutting protective bifidobacteria and raising diarrhea risk.

title: Intestinal Biomarkers and the Non-Motor Phenotype of Parkinson's Disease
description: Parkinson's patients with constipation show higher fecal calprotectin, reduced SCFAs, lower gut diversity, and greater IBD genetic risk, linking gut inflammation to non-motor severity.

title: HERFD-XAS: High-Resolution X-ray Speciation of Biological Metals
description: HERFD-XAS sharpens X-ray absorption spectra by rejecting core-hole broadening, resolving mercury, selenium, and arsenic speciation in dilute biological samples for metallomics.

title: Gut Microbiome and Childhood Stunting in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
description: Systematic review of 14 studies links childhood stunting in LMICs to inflammatory gut pathobionts and depleted butyrate producers, driving impaired linear growth.

title: Childhood Blood Metals and the Gut Microbiome: Evidence from the GESTE Cohort
description: GESTE cohort links childhood blood metals (Mn, Se, Cd, Hg, Pb) to gut microbiome composition in 6-7 year olds; manganese and selenium tied to bacterial phyla.

title: A Multi-Omics + MR Enterography Model for Predicting Bowel Damage in Crohn's Disease
description: Two-center study fusing gut microbiome, fecal and serum metabolomics, and MR enterography into a model predicting cumulative Crohn's bowel damage (AUC 0.857).

title: The Human Microbiome Across Body Sites: Gut, Skin, Oral, Vaginal and Lung
description: How the human microbiome differs across the gut, skin, oral, vaginal and lung niches, how it is acquired and disrupted, and why heavy-metal exposure matters.

title: Prenatal Metal Exposure, the Gut Microbiome, and Childhood Depression
description: A Mexico City birth-cohort study links a prenatal zinc-cobalt profile plus specific gut bacteria to 15.4% higher childhood depression scores at ages 9-11.

title: Prenatal Lead Exposure and the Childhood Gut Microbiome
description: Prenatal lead exposure is negatively linked to the childhood gut microbiome: metagenomics from a Mexico City cohort ties maternal Pb to fewer beneficial bacteria.

title: Prebiotics Blunt the Gut Cost of Iron-Fortified Cereal in Kenyan Infants
description: In a Kenyan infant RCT, adding prebiotic GOS/FOS to iron-fortified cereal raised iron absorption 60% and reduced gut inflammation, pathogens, and dysbiosis.

title: Nutritional Immunity and Trace Metals in Infection
description: How the host uses iron, zinc, manganese and copper handling as nutritional immunity to starve or poison pathogens, plus metal-based therapeutic strategies.

title: Metal Availability and Immune Function During Infection
description: How zinc, iron, manganese, and copper availability shapes neutrophil and macrophage function during infection through nutritional immunity, calprotectin, and phagosomal metal handling.

title: Iron Chelation Therapy in Transfusion-Dependent Thalassemia
description: Clinical review of deferoxamine, deferiprone, and deferasirox for transfusion iron overload in thalassemia, covering cardiac and hepatic iron outcomes measured by MRI T2*.

title: Heavy Metals and the Gut Microbiota: A Systematic Review
description: Systematic review of 12 human studies links arsenic, lead, mercury, and cadmium exposure to gut microbiota dysbiosis, leaky gut, and disease, with dietary mitigation.

title: Gallium as an Iron Mimic: Disrupting Pseudomonas Iron Metabolism in Cystic Fibrosis
description: Gallium substitutes for iron to sabotage Pseudomonas aeruginosa iron metabolism. A Phase 1 CF trial (Goss et al., Sci Transl Med 2018) found IV gallium improved lung function.

title: Copper in Infectious Disease: Both Sides of the Penny
description: How the immune system weaponizes copper against pathogens: macrophage copper bursts, phagosomal intoxication, fungal copper detox, and copper nutritional immunity.

title: Arsenic Exposure Reshapes the Gut Microbiome of Bangladeshi Children, Enriching Resistance-Carrying E. coli
description: Arsenic-exposed Bangladeshi children carry more gut Proteobacteria and E. coli bearing arsenic-resistance (ars) and antibiotic-resistance-like genes, a metal-microbiome case study.

title: Spatial Metallomics in Colorectal Cancer: Copper-Immune and Iron-EMT Pathways
description: Spatial metallomics pairs LA-ICP-TOF-MS with Visium transcriptomics in colorectal cancer, mapping copper to immune genes and iron to EMT at the tumor front.

title: Proteome-Scale Mapping of Iron-Binding Proteins in Bread Wheat
description: A proteome-wide scan of bread wheat mapped ~600 iron-binding proteins with Fe(II)/Fe(III) sites coordinated by His, Glu, Asp and Cys, aiding metallomics.

title: [NiFe]-Hydrogenase Cofactor Biosynthesis and the Hyp Maturation Proteins (HypA-F) in E. coli
description: How E. coli builds the NiFe(CN)2CO cofactor of [NiFe]-hydrogenases: the HypA-F maturation proteins, cyanide and CO ligand synthesis, and nickel insertion.

title: The Zinc Clasp: How Zn2+ Shapes T-Cell Signaling
description: The zinc clasp is a Zn2+-bridged interface that tethers the kinase Lck to CD4 and CD8 coreceptors, a labile-zinc switch central to T-cell activation and immunity.

title: The Iron Metalloproteome of Pseudomonas aeruginosa Under Oxic and Anoxic Conditions
description: Native metalloproteomics maps how Pseudomonas aeruginosa partitions iron across four protein complexes, with denitrification raising iron demand in anoxia.

title: Nitric Oxide Sensing by the [4Fe-4S] Regulator ArnR
description: ArnR uses a [4Fe-4S] cluster to sense nitric oxide: NO nitrosylates the cluster, abolishing DNA binding and derepressing nitrate-respiration and hmp genes.

title: Maternal Metallomic Profiles in Pregnancy with Obesity: A Secondary Analysis of UPBEAT
description: UPBEAT analysis profiled 18 serum metals in 755 pregnant women with obesity: elevated manganese linked to antepartum hemorrhage, phosphorus to NICU care.

title: Iron-Sulfur Clusters and Oxygen in Human Disease
description: How iron-sulfur (Fe-S) cluster biogenesis and oxygen shape human disease: NFS1 in lung cancer, hyperoxia injury, and hypoxia therapy for Friedreich ataxia.
